headline: The US and Canada are the big winners from the collapse of Qatar's LNG exports
summary: The US and Canada are emerging as the main beneficiaries of the collapse of Qatar's LNG exports. The months-long crisis in the Strait of Hormuz is reshaping global energy supply.
why: Qatar is one of the largest LNG exporters, and disruption through the Strait of Hormuz affects global gas prices and supply contracts. North American LNG exporters can gain from the gap.
why_moved: Loss of Qatari LNG shipments through the Strait of Hormuz tightens global gas supply. Buyers turn to other exporters such as the US and Canada, shifting energy trade flows.
